## ECR Club — Next Session (9 Dec)

::: section
![](https://thieled.github.io/ecpr-newsletter/issues/2025/12/img/ecr_club.png){.newsimg width="180"}

The PolComm ECR Club is pleased to announce its next online session on 9 December, 11:00–12:00 GMT, featuring Roy Aulie Jacobsen and his paper “An Emotional Reaction: Analysing the Public’s Response to Communication Tactics Used by Political Leaders in Norway during the COVID-19 Pandemic”. The study explores how different communication strategies on Facebook trigger emotional reactions and shape public engagement during the pandemic.
The PolComm ECR Club is a monthly forum open to PhD students and postdocs (≤4 years post-PhD) in the ECPR or ECREA political communication sections.

**Time:** Tuesday 11:00 - 12:00 GMT (09/12/2025)  \
**Presenter:** Roy Aulie Jacobsen, Kristiania University Oslo  \
**Discussant:** Pablo Jost, University of Mainz \
**Chair:** Nicoleta Corbu, SNSPA, Bucharest \

<button class="readmore">
<a href="https://ecpr.eu/Events/332">Read more</a>
</button>
:::
